recent_notebooks.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory

recent_notebooks.summary: Revised analysis confirms that irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks, characterized by algebraic conditions on stoichiometric submatrices, provide the necessary structure for chemical systems to maintain history-dependent states, distinguishing them from simple hysteresis.
recent_notebooks.title: Stoichiometric and Thermodynamic Constraints in Non-Equilibrium Chemical Persistence

recent_notebooks.summary: Stable heredity in prebiotic chemical systems requires balancing copying fidelity with the compositional stability afforded by structural subgraphs. Hereditary evolution emerges not merely from persistence, but from the network's ability to maintain functional stoichiometry through aggregated local interactions.
recent_notebooks.title: Copying Fidelity and Compositional Stability in Evolving Prebiotic Systems
